---
title: "7 Evaluate a single method"
---
Alternative labels: 

## Definition
These studies aim to assess a single method with respect to precision, bias, acceptance, variability introduced by methods users, or other outcomes. This type includes proof-of-concept studies that demonstrate whether a method can work in principle before larger-scale testing.

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples 
[Simulation study](../approaches/2simulation.qmd): random-effects meta-analysis;[@Hartung2001a] false positives when conducting subgroup analysis.[@Brookes2001subgroup]

[Reliability and agreement studies](../approaches/4reliability.qmd): reliability of risk of bias tools for observational studies;[@Kalaycioglu2023inter-rater] agreement between nine research teams attempting to reproduce the same observational study.[@Ostropolets2023reproducible] 

[Qualitative study involving researchers or other interest-holders in health research](../approaches/7qualitative.qmd): focus group addressing the clarity of plain language recommendations in guidelines.[@Santesso2022focus]

[Review of applied methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): quality and reporting of prediction models for COVID-19;[@Wynants2020prediction] quality and reporting of individual-participant data meta-analysis (nested within scoping review of such studies).[@Seidler2024state]
